datasets.title: Satellite detected water extent in Luuq & Doolow District, Gedo Region, Somalia as of 07 November 2023
datasets.description: UNOSAT code FL20231105SOM This map illustrates satellite-detected surface waters in Luuq & Doolow District, Gedo Region, Somalia as observed from a Sentinel-1 image acquired on 07 November 2023 at 02:54 UTC. Within the analysed area of about 12,500 km², about 150 km² of land appear to be flooded. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Important note: Flood analysis from radar images may underestimate the presence of standing waters in built-up areas and densely vegetated areas due to backscattering properties of the radar signal.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/water-extent-in-luuq-doolow-district-gedo-region-somalia-as-of-07-november-2023]
datasets.details: This is a preliminary assessment and has not yet been validated in the field. It is important to consider the characteristics of the source imagery used in the analyses when interpreting results. For damage assessments it should be noted that only significant damage to the structural integrity of the buildings analyzed can be seen in imagery, while minor damage such as cracks or holes may not be visible at all. For flood extractions using radar data it is important to note that urban areas and highly vegetated areas may mask the flood signature and result in underestimation of flood waters. Users with specific questions or concerns should contact unosat@unitar.org to seek clarification.

lineage.description: Sentinel-1 SAR imagery acquired on 07 November 2023 was analyzed by UNOSAT analysts through visual interpretation and multi-temporal image comparison to detect surface water extent changes. The resulting water polygons were digitized with area calculations (150 km² flooded within 12,500 km² study area) and delivered as geodatabase and shapefile formats with metadata fields including sensor date, sensor ID, and area measurements.

sources.name: United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT)
sources.description: Sentinel-1 synthetic aperture radar imagery analysis providing satellite-detected surface water extent mapping through comparison of multi-temporal radar images to identify notable changes in water presence.
